<b>Cogwork Underflies</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are small [[Cogwork Bugs|automaton]] [[Underworkers]] built to work in the scorching heat of the [[Underworks#Sub-area:_The_Cauldron|Cauldron]].<ref>Cogwork Underfly [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Small automaton built to work, without complaint, in the scorching heat of the Underworks' Cauldron."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Floats stationary in the air. If [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] approaches, it slowly floats towards her and spins bladed appendages in a circle around itself, dealing {{Damage|1}}.

Easy to avoid alone. Be aware of its position during platforming segments or around other enemies. Avoid using the [[Cogfly]] tool when attempting to platform using these enemies, since Cogflies can attack and defeat them before Hornet reaches them.

The Cogwork Underflies in the [[Clawline]] room are unique in that they will be replaced by another Cogwork Underfly roughly 3 seconds after being killed, akin to how [[Driftlin]]s and [[Skullwing]]s behave.

== Location ==
Cogwork Underflies can be found in the [[Underworks]], specifically in the Cauldron.
